separate_from: Frozen 20-week serial wholesaler benchmark in eval/run_eval.py

environment.counterparties: BeerEpisode constructs the same deterministic scripted counterparties from the unmodified ScenarioSpec for every policy

policy_interface.observation: the role-local observation rendered by beer_distribution_game.prompts.observation_user_message with action_format=json
policy_interface.system_prompt: beer_distribution_game.prompts.system_prompt for the exact ScenarioSpec and wholesaler role
policy_interface.response: one JSON object with exactly one key, quantity, whose value is a JSON integer in [0, 128]
policy_interface.invalid_action: terminate the episode as a protocol failure; do not repair or substitute an order
policy_interface.settlement: after 36 accepted policy actions, BeerEpisode runs the native three settlement weeks with zero orders and applies the native terminal exposure charge

reporting.primary: mean local wholesaler holding plus backlog cost including settlement and terminal exposure, with stderr across seeds
reporting.protocol_metric: protocol failure rate over episodes and format failure rate over attempted actions
reporting.stability_metric: native grade.stability.bullwhip_ratio or normalized order-volatility metric with its exact formula recorded
reporting.provenance: record split ID and purpose, per-episode seed, model and adapter hashes, git revision, RNG seed, config, GPU time, and API cost
